phase_decomposition.interpretation: Seeding begins before sched_process_exec and continues after exec during worker startup, all before historical _start() returns.

coverage.whole_panel_failure_reason: Two NO_STARTUP_SEED STACK identities had refill_stock probe misses (47 and 3); promoted seed specimens themselves were complete.
coverage.q64_critical_note: Promoted seed mechanism does not depend on the ambiguous identities.

mechanism.definition: During transient service/worker startup, before historical _start() returns, the final MainPID executes on the future stock CPU and performs memcg direct Q64 charges followed by refill_stock(...,63), leaving residual per-CPU stock that is later reused after controlled migration back to that CPU.
causal_chain: transient service process executes on future stock CPU
pre-exec and post-exec startup allocations trigger direct Q64 charges
matching refill63 deposits memcg stock on that CPU
worker later reaches READY and _start() returns on prep CPU
controller explicitly migrates worker back to stock CPU
measured first-Q64 boundary T is delayed by the inherited startup residual

next_falsifier: Constrain the transient service cgroup to the prep CPU from creation time; STARTUP_STOCK_SEED and the high-T cluster should collapse if the mechanism is causal.
